title: 第10章 鄂珑仙子第11章 丹道传承
content_zh:
炼丹房位于天枢峰北侧，是一座独立的院落。
院门口，立着一块石碑，上面刻着两个古朴的大字：丹院。
李福带着徐长生走进院子，一股浓郁的药香扑面而来。
院子里，几名青衣弟子正忙碌着，有的在清洗药材，有的在研磨药粉，有的在往炉膛里添柴。
“你在这儿等着。”
李福说了一声，便匆匆走进正中的一间丹房。
徐长生站在原地，目光扫过四周。
院子不大，却布置得井井有条。
东西两侧各有一排厢房，应该是存放药材的地方。
正北是一排三间丹房，此刻正中那间丹房门窗紧闭，隐隐能看到里面有火光闪烁。
片刻后，李福出来了。
他身后，跟着一个身穿灰袍的老者。
老者须发皆白，面容清瘦，一双眼睛却格外有神，目光如同实质一般扫过徐长生，让徐长生心头一凛。
筑基修士！
而且，比莫长老更强！
“就他一个？”老者的声音沙哑，听不出喜怒。
李福陪笑道：“是，云长老，这是刚从灵植园调来的杂役，徐长生，五行灵根。”
“五行灵根？”云长老眉头一挑，有些意外。
徐长生心头一跳，躬身道：“弟子徐长生，见过云长老。”
云长老收回目光，淡淡道：“既然来了，就留下吧。炼丹房的规矩，李福会告诉你。”

“记住，在这里，老老实实干活，不该问的别问，不该动的别动。”
“否则，上一任的下场，就是你们的榜样。”
说罢，他转身回了丹房。
李福松了口气，转向徐长生，脸上的笑容收了起来。
“从今天起，你就是炼丹房的杂役了。”
“在这丹院，云长老的话，就是铁律。”
“干活的时候，眼睛放亮点，手脚麻利点。云长老脾气不太好，惹恼了他，谁也救不了你。”
“跟我来，我给你安排住处。”
徐长生跟在李福身后，心中却思绪万千。
云长老。
一个筑基期的炼丹长老。
若能讨得他的欢心，学到一招半式的炼丹术，哪怕只能练出最低等级的丹药，他有小青葫在手，转手就能强化出极品丹药！
不急。
先站稳脚跟再说。
徐长生深吸一口气，跟着李福，正准备前往住处。
content_en:
The alchemy room is located on the north side of Tianshu Peak and is an independent courtyard.
At the entrance of the courtyard, there is a stone tablet with two simple characters engraved on it: Danyuan.
Li Fu took Xu Changsheng into the courtyard, and a strong medicinal fragrance hit his face.
In the courtyard, several Tsing Yi disciples were busy, some were cleaning medicinal materials, some were grinding medicinal powder, and some were adding firewood to the furnace.
"You wait here."
Li Fu said something and hurriedly walked into an alchemy room in the middle.
Xu Changsheng stood there and glanced around.
The yard is not big, but it is well organized.
There is a row of side rooms on the east and west sides, which should be where medicinal materials are stored.
To the north is a row of three alchemy rooms. At this moment, the doors and windows of the alchemy room in the middle are closed, and you can faintly see the flicker of fire inside.
After a while, Li Fu came out.
Behind him, followed an old man in gray robes.
The old man's beard and hair were all white, his face was thin, but his eyes were particularly bright. His gaze swept over Xu Changsheng like a real person, making Xu Changsheng's heart tremble.
Foundation-building monk!
Moreover, he is stronger than Elder Mo!
"Is he the only one?" The old man's voice was hoarse, with no hint of emotion or anger.
Li Fu said with a smile: "Yes, Elder Yun, this is the handyman who was just transferred from the Spiritual Planting Garden, Xu Changsheng, with the Five Elements Spiritual Root."
"Five Elements Spiritual Roots?" Elder Yun raised his eyebrows, somewhat surprised.
Xu Changsheng's heart skipped a beat, and he bowed and said, "Disciple Xu Changsheng, I have met Elder Yun."
Elder Yun withdrew his gaze and said calmly: "Since you are here, just stay. Li Fu will tell you the rules of the alchemy room."
"Remember, here, work honestly, don't ask what you shouldn't ask, and don't touch what you shouldn't touch."
"Otherwise, the fate of the previous president will be your example."
After that, he turned around and returned to the alchemy room.
Li Fu breathed a sigh of relief, turned to Xu Changsheng, and the smile on his face faded.
"From today on, you will be the handyman of the alchemy room."
"In this Alchemy Academy, Elder Yun's words are iron law."
"When you work, keep your eyes bright and your hands and feet sharp. Elder Yun has a bad temper. If you piss him off, no one can save you."
"Come with me and I will arrange a place for you."
Xu Changsheng followed Li Fu, but his mind was full of thoughts.
Elder Yun.
An alchemy elder in the foundation building stage.
If he could gain his favor and learn one and a half steps of alchemy, even if he could only produce the lowest level elixir, he would have the little green gourd in his hand, and he would be able to strengthen it to produce the best elixir!
No rush.
Let’s get a firm foothold first.
Xu Changsheng took a deep breath and followed Li Fu, preparing to go to his residence.
